achievements.name: First Brew
achievements.description: You brewed your very first potion. And the cauldron survived!

achievements.name: Flower Tosser
achievements.description: You threw 50 flowers into the cauldron. Magic has never smelled better.

achievements.name: Circle Master
achievements.description: You traced 10 magic glyphs without a single mistake.

achievements.name: It Blew Up!
achievements.description: You used the wrong flower... and the cauldron did not appreciate it.

achievements.name: Cauldron of Despair
achievements.description: You failed 10 potions in a row. At least you invented a new smell.

achievements.name: Speed Brewer
achievements.description: You brewed 10 potions in under a minute. Steam and power filled the air.

achievements.name: 100% Perfect Spell
achievements.description: You flawlessly cast a spell with absolute precision. Magic bows to your skill.

achievements.name: Five Fumbles
achievements.description: You botched five spells in a row. Even wizards have off days.

achievements.name: Potion Marathon
achievements.description: You survived and played for 240 seconds straight. Your stamina rivals a true alchemist.

achievements.name: Grand Alchemage
achievements.description: You've unlocked all other achievements. Your name echoes through potion history.
